title: Pooling Deep Well Plates by Column
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set up protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the number of plates (1‑5) and the number of columns per plate (1‑12) to be pooled, and select which mount (left or right) will hold the P300 multi‑channel pipette. Place the destination deep‑well plate in slot 11 of the deck.

steps.title: Transfer column sample to pool plate
steps.instruction: For each plate and each column, use the P300 multi‑channel pipette to aspirate 100 µL of sample from the source column and dispense it into the same column of the destination plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL from the current source column
Dispense 100 µL into the corresponding column of the destination plate
